thread:
marie: Quick sync — proposing an SLA-led isolation approach for multi-region routing. TL;DR: group tenants into SLA bands (gold/silver/bronze). Gold gets dedicated regional slices + strict affinity; silver uses shared slices with soft-affinity; bronze routed to best-effort pooled capacity. Thinking this could be our default for Q4 planning. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

alex: high-level looks sensible. main concerns: routing policy complexity, explosion of slice variants, and interactions with fallback policies. we should avoid combinatorial bands + region permutations.

priya: customers we've heard from (fin-startup, health partner) would pay for gold. also need a compliance lane for Private/VPC that enforces region+model pinning.

luis: on prioritization — propose gate criteria: 1) signed interest from 2 customers for gold, 2) infra cost model, 3) clear SLA wording. without cost numbers we can't commit sales.

ben: runtime note — per-tenant dedicated slices reduce KV cache hit-rate. small-tenants will see worse p95 unless we compensate with cache warming or reserved hot-cache. need a sim.

jason: ops/playbook concerns: automated evacuation, soft-evict, and safe fallback must exist. example runbook snippet: `evacuate --slice S --grace 300s --drain-concurrency 5` and circuit-breaker: failover to fallback band + alert.

alex: draft routing policy (proposal snippet):
```yaml
policy_version: v1
bands:
  - name: gold
    affinity: strict
    regions: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
    fallback: silver
  - name: silver
    affinity: soft
    regions: [us-east-1, us-west-2]
    fallback: bronze
  - name: bronze
    affinity: best_effort
    regions: [us-west-2]
```

priya: can we guarantee model pinning + region pin for the compliance lane? customers asked for both.

ben: model pinning is fine but reduces bin-packing. autoscale quotas + burst credits will be required for gold.

marie: Pilot plan suggestion — run two pilots: (A) gold-only dedicated slices for 2 paid customers, (B) mixed-run for 10 silver tenants. Measure: p50/p95 latency, cache hit-rate, cost per 100k tokens, and SLA-onboard friction. Launch criteria: latency delta for gold <10% vs baseline, 95% availability for gold, cost within 20% of our projection.

jason: add requirement: rollback plan + automated SLA-breach alerts wired to oncall and customer-success. also chaos tests for eviction paths.

alex: rough dev estimate: control-plane routing changes = 3 sprints, runtime+metrics+eviction tooling = 2 sprints, e2e testing + rollout automation = 1 sprint.

luis: I'll slot this on the prioritization board. if product secures two beta commitments, mark as High.

marie: action items: @luis compute cost model and revenue threshold, @ben run KV cache simulation with tenant-slicing, @jason draft runbook + alerts, @alex write RFC for routing policy and policy-versioning. I'll create calendar invite for a 30m follow-up to agree launch criteria. :calendar:

meetings-bot: Event created: "SLA-led isolation follow-up" Fri 10:00am (30m) — attendees: marie, alex, ben, jason, priya, luis

marie: thanks all :thumbsup:
